items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: swore me in then and there as a duly appointed special assistant to the District Attorney, Cumberland County, Maine

ctx.x: While being a guest in my home town of Portland, Maine last December -- I covered that in some tapes before, when my union presented me with a plaque, the District Attorney was present while I was setting up the drums, and he said he had heard about my accumulating standing as a peace officer in the different states, and he had heard of my father's standing in the past, and I told him that in all my travels around this country, and sheriff's appointments in other states, that with my family's background, I didn't…

So he went to his office and brought back a state of Maine, Cumberland County District Attorney Commission, signed and sealed, and swore me in then and there as a duly appointed special assistant to the District Attorney, Cumberland County, Maine, the 16th of December, 1978.
